title: In One Day

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: I stood in the ash of my own house
in the clothes that the fire had left
and the one who knows my name the best
stood close at my right hand.
He had a list and the list was true.
He did not have to lie.
Every word he laid against me
was a word I could not deny.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Then a voice above the accuser said
Is this not a brand from the fire
And nobody argued the burning
Nobody argued the smoke.
They took the filthy garments off me
While I stood there in the cold
And they set the fair mitre on my head
Before I was anything but old.

sections.label: Pre-Chorus
lines: And He laid a stone in the low ground
One stone, and He called it enough.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: In one day, in one day
What a hundred years could not wash away.
Seven eyes on a graven stone
And the guilt of the ground is gone
In one day.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Seven eyes and not one of them closing
Seven eyes and they miss nothing at all.
I had hoped to be seen a little less
I had hoped for a kinder count.
But the graving goes deep in the stone
And the stone does not complain
And whatever the chisel is taking
It is taking in my name.

sections.label: Pre-Chorus
lines: And He laid a stone in the low ground
One stone, and He called it enough.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: In one day, in one day,
What a hundred years could not wash away.
Seven eyes on a graven stone
And the guilt of the ground is gone,
In one day.

sections.label: Bridge
lines: Under the vine, under the fig tree,
A man calls his neighbour to come.
Not a throne, not a banner, not an army,
Just a shadow wide enough for two.
I have waited on the great deliverance.
I would settle for the shade.

sections.label: Final Chorus
lines: In one day, in one day,
Call your neighbour while the light is long.
Seven eyes on a graven stone
And the guilt of the ground is gone
In one day.

sections.label: Outro
lines: It was not this day.
It was not this day.
But the stone is already laid.
One day

epigraph: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments
